text:
sasha_cs: Cedarwell returned our vendor security form with a few asks: latest SOC2 Type II, backup encryption details, incident-notification SLA, and full subprocessor list. Renewal in ~6 weeks so want to avoid a blocker. :eyes:
onboard-bot: New submission recorded: https://forms.internal/cedarwell-2026 (PDF attached). Fields flagged: SOC2 report, backups encryptions, incident timeline, subprocessors, BYOK question.
olivia_sec: can you itemize which pieces are missing vs accepted?
sasha_cs: Missing: SOC2 Type II file, explicit backup-at-rest algorithm, incident notif timeline (<48h requested), and completed subprocessor list. They also asked if we support BYOK.
miguel_eng: BYOK is sensitive — for Hosted we don't ingest external keys. We can offer envelope encryption patterns and KMS audit logs. For Private deployments we support customer-managed keys.
chris_csm: renewal team marked as 'medium' risk if doc turnaround >10 business days. Propose we prepare a concise evidence packet and offer a 30m sync with their security lead.
olivia_sec: I'll draft the response: "We maintain SOC2 Type II controls; attached is a redacted report. Incident notifications: acknowledge within 24h, impact assessment within 72h, remediation plan within 10 business days." Agree?
miguel_eng: timelines sound good. For BYOK wording: "Customer-managed keys supported on Private deployments; for Hosted we provide provider-managed KMS with strict access controls and auditability; we do not accept external key imports"
sasha_cs: Great — please wrap that into a one-pager and attach a redacted SOC2. I'll submit to their form and propose Tue 10am PST for a 30m call.
chris_csm: I'll ask renewal to extend their internal review by a week if needed and offer a short enablement session on data handling to reassure them. :calendar:
olivia_sec: Upload plan EOD: 1) redacted SOC2 snippet, 2) encryption summary (algorithms + KMS logs), 3) incident SLA text, 4) link to subprocessor inventory.
miguel_eng: exporting a KMS audit sample + encryption config snippet now: ```json
{"disk_encryption":"AES-256-GCM","kms_provider":"aws-kms","key_rotation":"90d"}
```
sasha_cs: once uploaded I'll reply to Cedarwell and book the call. Marking account health as 'watch' not yet 'at-risk'.
onboard-bot: Reminder set to follow up on thread 4951234567 in 72 hours.
chris_csm: capturing feedback: Cedarwell requested clearer onboarding docs on backups and key handling — can we add a small FAQ to the onboarding deck? Quick win for renewals.
miguel_eng: can do a 2-slide FAQ and tag product for review.
sasha_cs: thanks team. I'll update the account dashboard and ping here after submission. :thumbsup:
